dispositions.name: Discharge with follow-up
dispositions.description: Home with a booked review appointment.
dispositions.mhca_basis: Voluntary outpatient care; the patient's right to access mental healthcare (s.18).

dispositions.name: Outpatient referral
dispositions.description: Refer to psychiatry OPD, psychotherapy or counselling services.
dispositions.mhca_basis: Right to access mental healthcare, including outpatient and community services (s.18).

dispositions.name: Independent admission
dispositions.description: A patient with capacity chooses to be admitted.

dispositions.name: Supported admission
dispositions.description: Admission with high support needs where the patient lacks capacity, with the nominated representative involved.
dispositions.mhca_basis: Supported admission up to 30 days (s.89), beyond 30 days (s.90), with Mental Health Review Board oversight; nominated representative (s.14).

dispositions.name: Admission of a minor
dispositions.description: Admission of a person under 18 at the request of the nominated representative.

dispositions.name: Emergency treatment (up to 72 h)
dispositions.description: Emergency treatment to prevent death or serious harm.

dispositions.name: Medically supervised detox
dispositions.description: Admission or day care for supervised withdrawal management.
dispositions.mhca_basis: Independent or supported admission as applicable (s.85-90).

dispositions.name: Referral to an OST centre
dispositions.description: Refer to an authorised opioid substitution therapy centre.
dispositions.mhca_basis: Not MHCA; NDPS Act 1985 and rules (OST only at authorised centres).

dispositions.name: Safety plan
dispositions.description: Short written plan: warning signs, coping steps, people to contact, removing means, and the Tele-MANAS helpline 14416.
dispositions.mhca_basis: Duty of care; attempted suicide presumed to be severe stress needing care (s.115).
